data.intent: Find coverage for Saturday's opening shift after a student staffer becomes unavailable.

route.owner_reason: Priya Shah knows this best (opening, scheduling, shift).
route.substitution_note: Priya Shah is off today, so their coworker answered from their notes and Joe Martinez takes the hands-on step.

data.context_shared: Priya handles shift cover through 7shifts and opens on weekends herself, so she knows the opening routine. Joe can check 7shifts for who is available Saturday morning and who has trained on opening.
data.should_check: Confirm in 7shifts that the replacement has Opening & closing training before assigning them, and check Square POS opening steps are covered.

data.context_shared: Ellie covers weekend shifts and uses 7shifts for scheduling, so the open Saturday opening slot is likely visible and swappable there.

data.context_shared: Joe handles ordering, Square POS, and customer reviews but has no notes on scheduling or staff availability. Shift coverage isn't in his responsibilities, so he may not know who's free Saturday.
data.should_check: Confirm with Joe whether anyone on staff has scheduling authority and whether Square POS shows who clocked in for past openings before contacting staff.

drafts.title: Saturday opening shift needs cover
drafts.body: Hi team, I need someone to cover Saturday's opening shift. It's posted in 7shifts under the trade app now. If you have Opening & closing training and are free Saturday morning, please claim it there, or text me at [phone] and I'll confirm with you. Thanks for helping keep us running, I really appreciate it! - Joe

drafts.title: Confirming your Saturday opening
drafts.body: Hi [Name], thanks for taking Saturday's opening shift at Joe's Corner Coffee. Please arrive at [time] and check in with the Square POS opening steps. I'll approve the swap in 7shifts today. Let me know if anything changes. See you Saturday! - Joe

drafts.title: Saturday morning hours note (optional)
drafts.body: Good morning! Quick heads up: Saturday we're opening as usual at [time], serving your favorite coffee and pastries. Come say hi and grab a cup before your day gets going. See you soon at Joe's Corner Coffee!
